item.title: Oil Prices Rise in Overnight Trading; Florida Gas Prices Face Uncertainty
item.description: Florida gas prices face new uncertainty this week as crude oil markets surged when trading opened Sunday night. item.title: Pensacola Beach Lifeguards Return
item.description: The Pensacola Beach Lifeguards returned to their towers Saturday for the 2026 lifeguard season.
